scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --directory backend pywrangler dev
scripts.format: prettier --write . && node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --directory backend ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.precommit:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.check:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.check: npm run precommit:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build -w frontend && node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --locked --directory backend pywrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:worker: node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --locked --directory backend pywrangler deploy

backend/**/*.py: node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff check --fix
node scripts/with-uv.mjs run --project backend ruff format
